spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (उ) कुजु (कोजति)
1 To steal or rob.
(इ) कुजि (कुञ्जति)
To sound inarticulately.

A tree.
f. (-जा)
1 A name of

Of SĪTĀ.
E.
कु the earth, and ज born, earth-born.

r. 1st cl. (कूजति)
To make any inarticulate sound, to utter a cry as a bird, to coo as a pigeon, to caw as a crow, &c.
With परि prefixed,
to moan.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A thief, a housebreaker; also कुजम्भल and कुजम्भर.

f. (-टिः-टी)
A fog or mist.
E.
कु the earth, and झट to be entangled, affix कि; also कुञ्झटिका.

f. (-का)
A fog or mist: see the preceding.

mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्)
Cooing.
E.
कूज to coo, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Cooing, moaning, uttering an inarticulate sound.
E.
कूज and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cooed, uttered inarticulately.
n. (-तं)
The cry of a bird, cooing.
E.
कूज to sound, क्त aff.
